claude-sonnet.doc: Template for a real agent arm, read by `run` (R6-b). No test executes it: running it spends money. Copy it per routine under test and change the model, effort, skill or hook flags. {brief} {tree} {capUsd} are filled in; the agent runs inside the prepared tree; cost is read from the JSON on stdout (total_cost_usd). R6-b adds the free stub arm its tests use.
cmd: Read BRIEF.md in the current directory and implement what it asks, with tests. Do not push, open PRs, search git history for the real fix, or touch anything outside this directory.
